legal_basis.from: County Commission moratorium action after the February 26, 2026 Planning and Zoning public hearing (notice published in Center Republican Feb. 19, 2026); the February 10, 2026 Commission motion approved placing the public hearing for "a recommended 90 days with final approval to take place at the March County Commission meeting"; KFYR reported the March 13, 2026 Commission meeting unanimously approved a 180-day pause [VERIFY 2026 resolution number from Oliver County clerk]
legal_basis.to: Resolution 2026-02, adopted at the March 13, 2026 Commission meeting: a 180-day moratorium on data center and cryptocurrency mining facilities, with the option to extend; moved by Commissioner Dave Berger, seconded by Commissioner Lee Husfloen, all in favor. The Planning & Zoning Board had recommended a 36-month term at second reading, but the Commission set 180 days instead, directing the State's Attorney (with help from other counties' State's Attorneys) to draft the permanent ordinance.

current_status.to: Rescinded as of 2026-04-30.
